site.title: Nodyx Extensions
site.tagline: Extensions for your community. Each one states what it can touch, before you install it.
fiche.install_hint: You will be sent to your instance's admin, which shows the permissions before installing.
fiche.nothing_touched: This extension asks for no permission.
fiche.not_found: This extension does not exist in this registry.
publish.title: Publish an extension
publish.intro: The registry is a folder of JSON files in the Nodyx repository. Publishing means opening a pull request: your submission keeps a public trace, and there is no account to create.
publish.step1: Write your extension following the SDK manual.
publish.step2: Check your package with the validation command, the very same the server runs.
publish.step3: Open a pull request with your registry entry.
publish.req_license: An open licence, and a link to the sources: nobody should install what they cannot read.
publish.req_perms: Permissions justified in the description: say why you need the network, not only that you do.
publish.req_i18n: At least the default language, complete. English is strongly advised for reach.
publish.req_immutable: A published version never changes. A fix is a new version.
publish.ref_tracker: Any tracker, any audience measurement, any telemetry.
publish.ref_unused: A permission with no visible use in the code.
publish.ref_opaque: Deliberately unreadable code, or a package shipped without its sources.
footer.free: Free, no commission, no sponsored ranking.
footer.no_stars: No stars: an average over three votes says nothing about what a package does to your instance.
footer.independent: If this site goes down, your instance loses discovery, never its extensions.
